text: In 2024-09, 16 of us said "the biden-harris administration," peaking 2024-09-19. 15 of us issued a "statement after voting." 13 named "a continuing resolution"; 11 called it "continuing resolution cr." 12 of us spoke of "the house floor." 11 of us said "the biden-harris administration's." 10 of us said "protecting american agriculture from foreign adversaries," first said by Dan Newhouse, and 10 said "american agriculture from foreign adversaries act."
